note: Moss Mouth's people are tools/worlds/homelands.json's (Moss Mouth Cavern): Elder Snikkit in the middle of the great hall gives the first two, Pitmaster Grukk a few steps from him the three hunts; Stitcher Nibb, across the hall to the south-west, is the outfitter; Coachman Rukkit keeps the stable in the south chamber, down the passage from the hall (his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes); the tunnel rats (the long west tunnel that runs south to the cavern's mouth), the cave bats (the far north-east chamber) and the spider Mother Mossweb (alone in the old camp outside the mouth, far to the south) are placed for these quests. Levels 7-20 (2026-11-11): Grukk gives L7-L15, Snikkit the L20 path; objectives on the Homelands' shared ground, the Goldfeather Eyrie (Rukkit's coach), in the goblins' manner: fur and a pelt to sell, a bargain at Dunmore's, a bounty paid by him.

L1.name: A Tunnel-Runner's Ear Ring
offer: A new one, yes? Hmm. Two ears, all your fingers. You will do. But no goblin of Moss Mouth runs the tunnels without the ear ring, or the lookouts take it for a thief.
Stitcher Nibb makes them, from rat bone and a bit of wire. Nibb sits across the hall, a few steps to the south-west.
Will you fetch your ear ring and show it to me?
L1.declined: Then stay where the lookouts can see you, little one.
L1.started: Go on, go on. Just across the hall. Nibb does not bite. Much.

piece.name: tunnel-runner's ear ring
piece.description: A ring of rat bone and wire. Every goblin of Moss Mouth Cavern wears one, so the lookouts know it in the dark.

fetch.journal: Ask Stitcher Nibb, across the hall south-west of Elder Snikkit, for a tunnel-runner's ear ring.
fetch.says: Snikkit sent you? Hold still. There: rat bone, good wire, hardly rusted. No charge for a new one. The next one costs you.

show.journal: Show the tunnel-runner's ear ring to Elder Snikkit.
show.says: Good, good. Now the lookouts will know you for one of ours. Do not lose it, little one.

L2.name: Bound to Moss Mouth
offer: A goblin who dies far from home is a goblin wasted. Have Spiritmaster Grizzik bind your spirit to the cavern, so that you wake here when something eats you.
Then put your mark in Coachman Rukkit's ledger. His coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes of the Homelands, for those their stables know.
Will you see them both and come back to me?
L2.declined: Then try not to die, little one. It is harder than it sounds.
L2.started: Grizzik sits just south-east of here. Rukkit keeps his coach in the south chamber, down the passage.

bind.journal: Have Spiritmaster Grizzik, south-east of the elder, bind your spirit to Moss Mouth Cavern.
bind.says: There. The cavern has you now. Fall, and you wake here in the dark with the rest of us. Now go and make your mark for Coachman Rukkit.

ledger.journal: Put your mark in Coachman Rukkit's ledger, in the south chamber down the passage from the hall.
ledger.says: A new mark for the ledger! My coach runs to Freeport and to every other home of the Homelands, for travelers whose names their ledgers hold. Yours is in mine now.

says: Good. Now you cannot get lost, and you cannot stay dead. Both are useful.
Rukkit's coach will take you to Freeport if its ledger knows you, but the road to Neriak is earned. Pitmaster Grukk, beside me, has work for you.

L3.name: Rats in the Long Tunnel
offer: You are the new one? Hah. Small. The tunnel rats are breeding in the long tunnel again, and they chew every sack we carry in from the mouth.
Go west out of the hall, then south down the long tunnel to the mouth. Kill rats until you have three tails, and I will teach you a thing worth knowing.
Will you clear some rats?
L3.declined: Scared of rats? Neriak will eat you whole.
L3.started: Three tails. Not ears, not feet. Tails.

drop.name: tunnel rat tail
drop.description: The tail of a tunnel rat from the long tunnel of Moss Mouth Cavern.

hunt.journal: Take three tunnel rat tails from the tunnel rats in the long tunnel that runs south to the mouth.

give.journal: Bring three tunnel rat tails to Pitmaster Grukk.
give.says: Three tails, and you still have your own. Hah! Good. Now watch what I do, and learn this.

L4.name: A Goblin's Arms
offer: The dark elves laugh at a goblin with empty hands. I will make you proper gear, but you fetch what I need.
Stitcher Nibb has a leather strip and a shaft put by for me. Then bring a wing from the cave bats that roost in the far north-east chamber.
Will you bring me all three?
L4.declined: Then fight with your teeth. See how long they last.
L4.started: Leather and a shaft from Nibb, a wing from the bats. Quick, now.

materials.journal: Ask Stitcher Nibb for the leather strip and the wooden shaft.
materials.says: For Grukk? Here, a leather strip and a shaft, straight enough. Tell him he still owes me for the last ones.

drop.name: cave bat wing
drop.description: The leathery wing of a cave bat from the north-east chamber of Moss Mouth Cavern.

hunt.journal: Take a cave bat wing from the cave bats in the far north-east chamber of the cavern.

give.journal: Bring the leather strip, the wooden shaft and the cave bat wing to Pitmaster Grukk.
give.says: All three. Give it here... wing for the grip, leather to bind. There. It is yours. Try not to cut yourself.

L5.name: Mother Mossweb
offer: One more thing before Neriak gets you. A great spider nests in the old camp outside the mouth, far to the south. We call her Mother Mossweb. She took two lookouts last moon.
She bites first and she bites deep, so do not stand and stare. Bring me her fang, and I will teach you the last thing I have for a new one.
Will you kill Mother Mossweb?
L5.declined: She will only get fatter while you wait.
L5.started: South, down the long tunnel and out past the mouth, among the old huts. Keep moving when she comes.

drop.name: Mossweb's fang
drop.description: The long black fang of the spider Mother Mossweb.

hunt.journal: Take Mossweb's fang from the spider Mother Mossweb, in the old camp outside the mouth, far to the south.

give.journal: Bring Mossweb's fang to Pitmaster Grukk.
says: Her fang! Hah! The lookouts will sleep tonight. You are no new one any more.
Learn this, and see Gatekeeper Skabber when you are ready for Neriak.

flight.name: The Road to Neriak
offer: The dark elves of Neriak pay well for goblins who are quick and quiet, and Grukk says you are both.
You have earned the road, little one. I will set you down among your own guild in Neriak, and your spirit will rest there.
Shall I send you to Neriak?
flight.declined: Neriak will wait. Dark elves are good at waiting.
flight.started: Keep your blade close and your purse closer!
flight.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Skabber when you are ready to go to Neriak.

L7.name: Furs for Neriak
offer: Back again, and bigger! Hah. Listen. The dark elves of Neriak pay good coin for white fur, and the Eyrie's snow is full of drift rats wearing it.
Ride Rukkit's coach to the Goldfeather Eyrie. The rats run on the snow east of the hunters' outpost. Three clumps of fur, clean, no holes.
Will you skin some rats for Grukk?
L7.declined: No fur, no coin. Come back when you want both.
L7.started: Three clumps. And keep your own ears warm. Cold ears snap off.

drop.name: drift rat fur
drop.description: A clump of white fur from a drift rat of the Goldfeather Eyrie's snow.

hunt.journal: Take three clumps of drift rat fur from the drift rats east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring three clumps of drift rat fur to Pitmaster Grukk in Moss Mouth.
give.says: White as a dark elf's lie! Hah. These fetch a fine price. Here, your share is a lesson. Watch, and learn this.

L10.name: Grukk's Bargain
offer: Your blade is a toy now, little one. Grukk made a deal with the Eyrie's quartermaster: he gives you ore and a shaft, and we say nice things about him.
Get them from Quartermaster Dunmore at the outpost. Then bring me silk from the rime spiders north-east of it, three skeins, to bind it all.
Will you fetch Grukk's bargain?
L10.declined: Then keep your toy, and hope nothing bites.
L10.started: Dunmore first. Do not let him talk you into paying.

materials.journal: Ask Quartermaster Dunmore at the Eyrie outpost for the ore and the shaft Grukk bargained for.
materials.says: A goblin from Grukk. Of course. Here is his ore, and his shaft. Tell him we are square, and count your fingers on the way out.

drop.name: rime spider silk
drop.description: A skein of frosted silk from a rime spider of the Goldfeather Eyrie.

hunt.journal: Take three skeins of silk from the rime spiders north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring the iron ore, the wooden shaft and the rime spider silk to Pitmaster Grukk.
give.says: Ore, shaft, silk, and nobody paid a copper. Hah! A moment... there. A real weapon. It is yours. Do not sell it.

L13.name: The Old Cat's Coat
offer: Here is a thing. A snow leopard the Eyrie folk call Old Frostjaw hunts the slopes north-east of their outpost. His pelt would buy half of Neriak.
He is old and he is mean and he bites first. Take friends from the other homes and promise them nothing. Bring Grukk the pelt.
Will you bring me Old Frostjaw's pelt?
L13.declined: Then some other goblin gets rich. Not you.
L13.started: Go with friends. Let them stand in front.

drop.name: Old Frostjaw's pelt
drop.description: The scarred grey pelt of Old Frostjaw, the snow leopard of the Eyrie's slopes.

hunt.journal: Take Old Frostjaw's pelt, on the slopes north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring Old Frostjaw's pelt to Pitmaster Grukk.
give.says: Look at it! Scars and all. The dark elves will fight over it. You did well, little one. Learn this.

L15.name: Ice That Never Melts
offer: The Eyrie folk whisper about a cold thing in the ice caves north-east of their outpost. They call it the Rimeheart. It is made of ice that never melts.
Ice that never melts! Do you know what a wizard in Neriak pays for that? Break it and bring me a shard. Only one. Grukk is not greedy.
Will you break the Rimeheart for Grukk?
L15.declined: Then the wizards keep their coin. Shame.
L15.started: Take friends. Big ones. Do not tell them what the shard is worth.

drop.name: shard of the Rimeheart
drop.description: A shard of blue ice that never melts, broken from the Rimeheart.

hunt.journal: Take a shard from the Rimeheart, in the ice caves north-east of the Eyrie outpost.

give.journal: Bring the shard of the Rimeheart to Pitmaster Grukk.
give.says: Cold! Cold, and it does not drip. Hah! Grukk will be rich. And you will be clever, because now I teach you this.

L20.name: The Bounty
offer: Grukk says you came home with ice that does not melt and a pelt worth a house. Hmm. You are no little one now. Time the other homes knew Moss Mouth's name.
The Eyrie's warden pays a bounty on the raiders that plague his river. Go to Warden Halvek at the outpost, do his work, and come home to me.
Will you take the warden's bounty?
L20.declined: The bounty will keep. The raiders will not.
L20.started: Rukkit's coach will take you. Bring home the coin, and yourself.

road.journal: Find Warden Halvek at the Eyrie outpost.
road.says: Snikkit's goblin, come for the bounty? Fine. The Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of here carry war-talons. Bring three to Dunmore: he pays.

drop.name: Goldfeather war-talon
drop.description: A war-talon of the Goldfeather aviaks, bound in gold thread.

hunt.journal: Take three war-talons from the Goldfeather raiders round the eyrie east of the Eyrie outpost.

handin.journal: Bring the three war-talons to Quartermaster Dunmore for the bounty.
handin.says: Three talons, and Halvek's word on them. Here is the bounty. No, you may not count it twice. Go home, goblin. You earned it.

final.journal: Return to Elder Snikkit in Moss Mouth.
final.says: Back, and with a fat purse! The other homes will say Moss Mouth's name now, and say it carefully. One thing more: choose your road.
